description.value:
Trigger you are hit by an attack

Take 2 fewer damage per level from the triggering attack. You saw the version where it landed, and moved a little out of that one.

cinderfall.incomplete: Trigger: hit by an attack. Take 2 fewer damage per level from that attack. A one-shot reactive flat damage reduction to a single named triggering attack has no precedent: the only live use of a `"damage-received"` selector found (`pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/class-features/adept-benefit-chalice.json`, `pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/abomination-vaults-bestiary/.../bone-gladiator.json`) pairs it only with `Note` (a chat-flavor annotation), never `FlatModifier`. `Resistance` is a standing, type-keyed value, not a one-shot flat reduction to one named triggering attack.
